tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Hero orange. RGB 234 117 0. CMYK 0 50 100 8. Pantone nearest 151 C. Fills: primary buttons, the logo tile, active nav marker, toggles on, the waveform motif. Ink-900 text on it passes (6.3:1). Never white text on it (3.0:1) and never orange-500 text on white.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of orange-500 fills. RGB 204 102 0. Ink-900 on it 4.9:1.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Orange as text: links, active tab labels and selected values on white (5.3:1) and orange-100 (4.8:1). RGB 168 84 0.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Orange as text and icons on dark grounds: ink-900 (8.2:1), charcoal-800 (6.6:1). RGB 255 143 31.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Orange tint. Icon tiles on stat cards, selected table rows, the active nav row in light mode. Ink-900 on it 17:1.

tokens.name: orange-900
tokens.usage: Deep orange. Icon tiles and selected rows in the dark theme. Orange-400 on it 6.4:1, grey-100 13:1.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Brand black, warm. RGB 20 17 15. CMYK 0 15 25 92. Headings and body text on light grounds (18.8:1 on white), text on orange fills, the logo tile. Dark theme page background.

tokens.name: charcoal-800
tokens.usage: Warm charcoal. RGB 42 37 34. The sidebar in the light theme, footers, raised panels in the dark theme. Grey-100 text on it 13.6:1, orange-500 5.1:1.

tokens.name: charcoal-850
tokens.usage: Between ink and charcoal. The sidebar in the dark theme, so it still separates from the ink page.

tokens.name: grey-700
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white (9.2:1) and grey-100 (8.2:1). Table headers, helper text.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and inactive icons on white (5.8:1). Lowest grey allowed for readable text in light mode.

tokens.name: grey-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative strokes only in light mode (3.0:1 on white). Secondary text in dark mode (6.3:1 on ink-900).

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Borders, dividers, input outlines and table rules on white. Decorative waveform bars on grey-100.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Warm off-white. App background behind cards, table header fill, raised panels. Text on the sidebar.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Cards and inputs in the light theme; white text only on ink, charcoal and the deep status tints.

tokens.name: success-600
tokens.usage: Registered, online, answered, resolved. Text on white 5.1:1, on success-100 4.6:1. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-400
tokens.usage: Success text and dots in the dark theme (8.2:1 on ink-900).

tokens.name: success-100
tokens.usage: Background of success banners and the Registered pill.

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: Unreachable, failed, missed, destructive actions. Text on white 5.6:1, danger-100 4.9:1.

tokens.name: danger-400
tokens.usage: Danger text in the dark theme (7.5:1 on ink-900).

tokens.name: danger-100
tokens.usage: Background of error banners, failed-registration pills, destructive confirm panels.

tokens.name: warning-700
tokens.usage: Warning text: certificate expiring, missing emergency address, plan limit near. 6.5:1 on warning-100. Brown-amber on purpose so it never reads as the brand orange.

tokens.name: warning-300
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons in the dark theme (11.2:1 on ink-900).

tokens.name: warning-100
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners and Expiring pills.

tokens.name: info-600
tokens.usage: Informational banners, inline help links, the focus ring in light mode (5.8:1 on white). Blue keeps focus distinct from the orange brand.

tokens.name: info-400
tokens.usage: Info text and the focus ring in the dark theme (7.0:1 on ink-900, 6.4:1 on charcoal-850).

tokens.name: info-100
tokens.usage: Background of informational banners.
